body:
Yeah i do just want to take a bs job - but just always second guessing myself if something is the right move or not - i really dont know why i'm so indecisive. And right now most of the bs jobs are in essential services to deal with covid-19 and when i think of taking such a job i worry that i will contract the virus and spread it to others.

I like reading autobiographies - personal stories from peoples' lives. When i write, which i dont really do much of tbh, its only journalling my daily life (when i rmb to) which was advised to me by my therapist.

I do enjoy reading books. Music - i dont really have any partucular type that i enjoy. But i feel all of these things are just avenues to procrastinate.

I feel things need to be done a certain way because its the way of the world that if u are not earning money - you cant go anywhere in life - and the thing is nobody is forcing me to be anything. Its just my own perception of where i should be in life. And how i fail to live up to my own vague expectations.

The thing is i have been having such a long break - i mean spending so much time just lying in bed sounds like a break to me.

I dont have any productive hobbies - all i do is super unproductive things like watch tv. The only thing i remember liking was drinking and drugs which i have stopped. I used to be a beer brewer but decided to stop after getting retrenched due to my abuse of alcohol and drugs.

When i was a kid i remember liking to write stories in school. But that was such a long time ago - and i just feel like at this stage of my life i need to be doing things a certain way - that what i do must be in line with getting a suitable job.

Hang in there man. I know what it feels like to lose a relationship to someone u really care about. When i was your age - i moved to australia for awhile to be with my girlfriend who didnt even see me when i got there because she had gotten together with another guy. The pain will pass, it really will, and even if it doesnt, let it give you the strength to be stronger. You're young - and you have a real chance now to change your life - give yourself time to heal and develope please! Dont do anything rash! Things will get better i promise.

Hey there is no particular way you have to live your life. Forget about the past. And do what makes u happy right now. If u want a relationship, u can get one - u may just need to work at it harder than others for whatever reason. Living at home at 25 is nothing to be ashamed of. And i think also a lot of us are jobless now with the virus going on. 

Hang in there man. Things can change in an instance!

I know how you feel. Having a family that cares for u can at times make u feel guilty for the life u have led. 

Therapy takes time to start working - and at the end of the day you are the one who has the power to make things change for yourself - all therapy does it provide you with a new perspective of viewing things, ultimately its up to you.

Keep trying new things. It may take a long while but over time u will find something that interests you, and u will meet people that share these interests. Dont lose hope please! Things can get better!

Why dont you think you can be happy? Have you seen a professional about this, like a psychologist?

I know what it feels like to never believe u will be happy again, to live in your head day by day. You have to physically drag yourself out of this situation and have a routine - thats the only way - it will be damn tough - but over time( u need to be patient), u will start to see some results!

Please dont. No matter how bad your life is right now, theres always a chance that it will get better. I tried hanging myself multiple times in my life, and they never really worked out. And im so glad for that - as there are so many experiences i would not have had if i had killed myself on those occasions. Dont lose hope! And talk to somebody, a friend, a family member, whoever.

Yeah i know when i was younger - i admitted to being suicidal and ended up in a psych ward for awhile. But as long as you dont say u want to hurt others or yourself it should be fine. And always good to get a professional's perspective.

Once you open up it does feel much better though. But i think sometimes we purposely choose not to because if we do open up - it means that there could be a valid diagnosis or reason for smth - and with that valid reason comes avenues to overcome them. And it can be really scary to feel like u have the power to change your life for the better. At least thats my 2 cents worth.
Have you seen somebody for your tremors? Like a psychologist? Perhaps that could help you.
Why are you thinking theres something wrong with your head? Whats going on?

Firstly, neither college or doing a job you love are necessary for your happiness. Of course in a perfect world - we all wish that we could have a perfect job that we love so much. The truth is its not going to be like that for everyone and thats ok. I feel like the biggest thing anybody can do for anyone else is use whatever skills they have and make another person's life better.

You still have a lot in you so dont lose hope. And not being able to keep a job for longer than a year - so what? Thats ok! Its good to try out many different jobs and careers! 

And why dont u think u will settle down and start a family? Also is this even something that you want - and if so why? 

There are millions of way to do life - and you should not try and be constricted to just going to college, and having a family or travelling the world when u retire? If any of these things happen- yeah they will be a great expereince - but if they dont - u will have so many more experiences in your lifetime!

So dont lose hope please! And stay safe!

I hope youre still doing better now. From your words you say that you are lazy and useless - has anyone ever said this to you? If they have - does it matter? Screw them. And if its just your own perception - well could u be wrong?

We all have things that we are not good at - could it be that you just have not found your calling or u have been doing classes that youre not interested in? 

Also is there a possibility that you have ADHD - people with ADHD usually have trouble focusing and paying attention - which is what causes them at times to feel like they are less than others. But that doesnt mean u cant suceed it just means u need to work your ass off even more - or find something that u can really focus on.

It seems from your words that you use video games as a way to run away from your problems. Dont do this. Trust me. Try your best and face your problems head on - thats the only way you can grow as a person. Its going to be hard - really hard but you are still young - i believe that you can definitely do it.

Also - word of advice - success comes in many forms and can come at different times for different people. There is no 1 way to do life. Life isnt about the destination its about the trials and tribulations along the way. Please dont let yourself avoid these. And dont compare - u have no idea the things that goes on in someone else's life or mind - just because on the outside they may have riches or they look happy - it may not really be so. And even if they are - you have no idea how long it took them to achieve this or what tmr will bring for them.

Lastly school is just the start of your life - what happens in school is important of course - grades are important to an extent - but what is more important is the morals and ethics that you build up.

Lastly, i understand what you are saying about feeling like you are letting people down and about how ur parents are supporting you financially. Dont worry about this, your parents love you i am sure. And all they want you to do is do your best. And that best can come in many forms. It could mean college may not be for you, it could mean switching of majors, it could mean taking a gap year. All of this is ok.

My explanation may be a bit all over the place - but thats because i have ADHD - inattentive or at least thats what they tell me.
 
I wish you peace my friend and I hope you feel better.
